pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Verse 1]
I said it was love at the very start
But it was kindness, gentle care
Your shining smile shook my heart
And slowly made its way inside me

[Pre-Chorus]
When it turned into love, you changed
Even your touch was filled with fear
Our hearts grew closer than our breath
And somehow started closing in on me

[Chorus]
I loved you, but I couldn’t breathe
The nights where hope swallowed up love
The tighter I held you, the more I broke
I’m sorry… I’m starting to feel afraid

[Verse 2]
Your love kept growing bigger
Mixed with fear and quiet obsession
Happiness faded, I had no air to breathe
I ran away from your heart like I was escaping

[Pre-Chorus]
Even the good days began to suffocate
I hid my guilt behind falling tears
Every step I took for you
Ended up saving only me

[Chorus]
I loved you, but I couldn’t breathe
We lost sight of each other along the way
Even knowing I’d become the villain to you
I carry the guilt… and disappear

[Bridge]
If I was everything in your world
Where would you even look for me?
To keep love from losing itself
The choice I made was pain

[Final Chorus]
The name we called “love”
Was too heavy, even the tears
The pain… in the end, it was us
Thank you…
I love you…
“And goodbye”
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
